preconditions.description: The number of vertices n is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.
The diameter d is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.
The maximum degree k is between 1 and 400,000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output is either 'NO' or 'YES' followed by n-1 lines describing the edges of the tree.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or all(len(line.split()) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', each of the n-1 lines describing edges contains exactly two integers.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or all(1 <= int(x) <= n for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] for x in line.split())
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', all vertex numbers in the edge descriptions are between 1 and n inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or len(set(tuple(sorted(map(int, line.split()))) for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])) == n - 1
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', all edge descriptions are unique and there are exactly n-1 edges.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or all(len(set(map(int, line.split()))) == 2 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', each edge description connects exactly two distinct vertices.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or all(degree <= k for degree in [sum(1 for line in stdout.splitlines()[1:] if str(v) in line.split()) for v in range(1, n + 1)])
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', the degree of each vertex is at most k.

postconditions.expression: stdout == 'NO' or (len(stdout.splitlines()) == 2 and n == 1 and d == 0) or (len(stdout.splitlines()) > 2 and d == max(len(path) - 1 for path in all_simple_paths(graph, 1, n)))
postconditions.description: If the output is not 'NO', the diameter of the tree is d, where the diameter is the maximum length of a simple path between any two vertices.
